projectContext: Example: a web app with a Rails API, a Next.js frontend and a shared UI package in one Yarn-workspaces monorepo.

notes: Example fact: the backend test job runs the whole suite, so green means every spec passed.
Example fact: the frontend test job only installs dependencies (its test step is disabled), so green proves nothing; require test evidence in the PR description.
Example fact: the lint step ends with `|| true`, so a green lint job does not prove the code is lint-clean.
Example fact: jobs that are `skipping` are normal when the change-detection job finds nothing relevant.
